# Playzy

> Playzy is a browser games platform with free games that run in a web browser. Most games can be played without an account or installation. Infinite World requires an account for multiplayer worlds and saved progress.

Playzy is built and maintained by Dharmik Gohil ([dharmikgohil.art](https://dharmikgohil.art)). The catalogue currently includes 22 playable games; each title below links to its game page.

## Playable games

- [Among Us: Pixel Outpost](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/among-us-pixel-outpost/): Explore a pixel space outpost, complete crew tasks, watch for sabotage, and vote in meetings against computer-controlled crewmates.
- [Bloom Loop: Garden Colour Flow](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/bloom-loop/): Direct bee drones around a vine loop and match colours to clear flower tiles with pollen bursts.
- [Cash Tycoon: Fame & Fortune](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/cash-tycoon/): Open businesses, hire managers, collect profits, and expand your tower.
- [Flappy Bird 3D](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/flappy-bird-3d/): Time each flap to guide a bird through a colourful 3D obstacle course.
- [Pixels: Farm, Craft & Adventure](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/pixels-farm-craft/): Grow crops, gather resources, craft supplies, and complete quests in a pixel adventure.
- [Shop Tycoon: Market Empire](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/shop-tycoon/): Place shop fixtures, stock products, set prices, and manage staff in an isometric store simulation.
- [Apex Velocity: F1 Supercar Studio](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/apex-velocity/): Drive and tune supercars, race iconic tracks, and create custom circuits.
- [VoxelCraft: Survival & Building](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/voxelcraft/): Explore, survive, and build in a 3D sandbox world.
- [Gravity Switch](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/gravity-switch/): One-button arcade reflex game. Tap or press Space to invert gravity, dodge floor/ceiling spikes, and chain combos.
- [Gravity Shift](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/gravity-shift.html): Arcade platform game. Jump between platforms with Space, W, or Up Arrow and avoid hazards.
- [Hextris Stack](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/hextris/): Hexagonal Tetris-style puzzle. Rotate the central hexagon with Left/Right to match 3+ blocks of the same color.
- [Color Switch](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/color-switch/): Neon color-matching arcade game. Tap to jump through obstacle gaps that match your current color.
- [Tower Stacker](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/tower-stacker/): Precision block-stacking game. Drop each sliding block dead-center to keep full width and build a streak.
- [Neon Snake](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/neon-snake/): Classic snake rebuilt with combo chains, five power-ups, wall portals, and hazards.
- [Block Merge](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/block-merge/): 2048-style merging puzzle with a chain multiplier and rescue tools (undo, hammer, shuffle).
- [Turbo Drift](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/turbo-drift/): Endless 3D highway racer. Steer into drifts and bank nitro by grazing traffic.
- [Monsoon Rickshaw Rush](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/monsoon-rickshaw-rush/): Drive a Mumbai auto-rickshaw through monsoon streets, pick up passengers, and deliver fares.
- [Ball Drop](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/ball-drop/): Plinko-style physics game with adjustable risk and multiplier buckets.
- [City Sprint](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/city-sprint/): Rooftop endless runner. Jump and double-jump across the skyline collecting coin chains.
- [Infinite Runner](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/infinite-runner/): Pixel-art endless runner with five procedurally generated biomes and stacking power-ups.
- [Infinite World](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/infinite-world/): Multiplayer 3D city builder. Build roads, towers, parks, rail and rivers, grow a hamlet into a metropolis, and invite friends to build the same world live. Account required (username and birthday); worlds can be private or public. [Privacy](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/infinite-world/privacy/) · [Terms](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/infinite-world/terms/) · [Support](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/infinite-world/support/)
- [Mario King](https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/games/mario-king/): Six-kingdom pixel-art platformer. Run, jump and stomp goombas across Grass, Desert, Cave, Ice and Sky kingdoms, then defeat the King in the Castle Kingdom boss fight. Controls: arrow keys/WASD to move, Space/Up/W to jump (hold for a higher jump), Down/S to duck and dodge the boss's attacks.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- Each listed game is playable and its page includes game-specific instructions and controls. Infinite World is the only game that requires an account.
- The site uses crawlable path URLs. The sitemap is available at https://playzy.dharmikgohil.art/sitemap.xml.
